method.sample: Read-only /tmp/inventory-sample.json copied into a disposable fixture authority; production policy state was never accessed
method.before: Original source, with only MAX_STATE raised for measuring projected load/save that otherwise cannot pass the old byte cap
method.merge: 6000 new retained entries into a clone of the sample; entry generation and cloning excluded from timing, transient index creation included
method.syntheticImport: Full canonical importRetainedPublicationMember, 3000 source URL/hash tuples sharing example.org, 10 MiB padding plus source metadata; fresh isolated fixture authority
method.projectedInventory: 38658 schema-valid entries, synthetic publication member paths padded to match the sample's average bytes/entry; 74290427 serialized bytes including newline
method.completeBaseline: After-only full canonical imports of every source-bearing scoped sealed out/ member into two fresh disposable managed destination trees, 58 imports / 27890 entries; source-free members omitted from source enrollment, not fabricated
method.validation: Both load and save retain full strict Zod validation. Measured projected schema validation was 518 ms versus 1245 ms full save, so a second incremental validation implementation was not introduced
method.temporaryScript: Throwaway benchmark script and injected export-only source copies removed after measurement; no network, models or production-state operations

capacity.formula: 2 * 13945 retained tuples + 2572 existing non-retained entries + 3 * 732 crawl budget + 3 * 2000 native budget
capacity.nativeBudgetBasis: Conservative allowance for three bounded runs, not an observation of actual future native entry counts

verification.testCommand: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 test/civic-opt-out.test.ts test/polite-fetch.test.ts test/district-retained-import.test.ts test/district-crawl.test.ts test/civic-docker.test.ts test/district-git-snapshot-import.test.ts test/prepare-knowledge.test.ts
newRegressions: 30000 shared-path references exceed 16 MiB, load/save in unchanged v1 format with stable entry ordering, then an inventory above 256 MiB fails closed before a managed write callback
Bulk host checks validate every URL including duplicate-host credential URLs, and a subsequent boundary observes a new objection
Shared-path digest reuse still rejects mismatched hashes and revoked references

compatibility: Existing inventory schemaVersion 1, keys, provenance kinds, state values and insertion order unchanged. The sample was loaded by the new full reader and saved using an isolated copied authority marker with matching inventory UUID; the larger synthetic inventory retaining every sample entry was then saved and loaded. Indices are only WeakMap-owned transient in-memory state. Byte cap remains enforced on read and save (including newline).
